widgets_values:
# Storyboard: up to 8 matching keyframes from one image with Qwen Image Edit 2511

Edits one anchor image, a reference or a character's photo, into one keyframe per scene with Qwen Image Edit 2511, each scene with its own sentence, the shared look and its own seed, and saves the keyframes as one batch.

## Models

- [qwen_image_edit_2511_fp8mixed.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-Edit_ComfyUI/resolve/main/split_files/diffusion_models/qwen_image_edit_2511_fp8mixed.safetensors): Qwen Image Edit 2511, fp8 mixed, [Apache-2.0](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen-Image-Edit-2511).
- [qwen_2.5_vl_7b_fp8_scaled.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/HunyuanVideo_1.5_repackaged/resolve/main/split_files/text_encoders/qwen_2.5_vl_7b_fp8_scaled.safetensors): Qwen2.5-VL 7B text encoder, fp8, [Apache-2.0](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct).
- [qwen_image_vae.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image_ComfyUI/resolve/main/split_files/vae/qwen_image_vae.safetensors): Qwen Image VAE, [Apache-2.0](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image_ComfyUI).

Rosesfield ships no weights. Each loader lists its file with a download link.
